meta.actor: Claude — consolidation pass (no research, no content rewriting)
meta.scope: Every Grok batch file for Uruguay merged into one file. Records are byte-faithful to the batches except for the normalisations listed in _consolidation.

reports.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadística (INE) — institutional statistical identity
reports.description: National statistical office of Uruguay. Produces the core official statistics (prices, household surveys, poverty, national accounts inputs, census, etc.) and coordinates the national statistical system.
reports._notes: Institutional parent node for Uruguayan official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.
_referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and technical reports
Banco Central del Uruguay statistical publications that cite INE sources

reports.title: Encuesta Continua de Hogares (ECH) / Continuous Household Survey
reports.description: Continuous household survey that is the primary source for labour-market indicators, household income, and income-based poverty and inequality measurement. National coverage with Montevideo / Interior domains.
reports._notes: Central social and labour survey. Continuous high-frequency operation. Official source for both labour statistics and monetary poverty. Recent poverty (persons) in the mid-to-high teens percent range under the updated methodology.

reports.title: Pobreza por el método del ingreso / Income poverty
reports.description: Official income-poverty and indigency incidence, calculated by comparing household income (from ECH) with nationally defined poverty and indigency lines. Published with Montevideo / Interior and other breakdowns.
reports._notes: Headline social indicator. 2025: persons under the poverty line ~16.6–17.7% depending on semester; indigency ~1.5–1.8%. Methodology updated in recent years (new baskets and economies of scale). Uruguay records among the lower income-poverty rates in the region.

reports.title: Líneas de pobreza e indigencia
reports.description: Monetary values of the poverty and indigency lines (per capita / household), differentiated for Montevideo and the Interior and updated with price information.
reports._notes: Direct input into the poverty measurement. Separate lines for Montevideo and Interior reflect cost-of-living differences.

reports.title: Índice de Precios al Consumo (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
reports.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services.
reports._notes: Flagship price statistic. Direct input into monetary-policy analysis by the Banco Central del Uruguay and into the updating of poverty lines.

reports.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Uruguay
reports.description: System of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income. Quarterly and annual releases.
reports._notes: Core macroeconomic statistical system. BCU plays a central role in the compilation and dissemination of the national accounts.

reports.title: Banco Central del Uruguay — statistical publications (monetary, external, inflation)
reports.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, and inflation analysis under an inflation-targeting regime.
reports._notes: In the Uruguayan division of labour INE leads prices, household surveys and poverty; the BCU leads national accounts, monetary, external and financial statistics and conducts inflation-targeting policy.

reports.title: Informe de Política Monetaria (IPoM)
reports.description: Quarterly Monetary Policy Report of the central bank. Explains recent inflation, the outlook, and the implications for the monetary-policy stance under the inflation-targeting regime.
reports._notes: Flagship policy communication product. Complements higher-frequency monetary-policy statements.

reports.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
reports.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys.
reports._notes: Foundational demographic product. Continuously cited by ECH design and poverty analysis.

reports.title: Índice de Pobreza Multidimensional (IPM)
reports.description: Official multidimensional poverty index capturing deprivations across multiple dimensions beyond income. Complements the income-poverty series.
reports._notes: Complementary structural poverty measure. Recent estimates place multidimensional poverty in the high teens percent range, with higher incidence outside Montevideo and among children and Afro-descendant populations.

reports.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
reports.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and changes in reserve assets.
reports._notes: Core external-accounts product. Recent current-account balances have been close to zero or mildly in deficit; goods and services trade is typically in surplus, offset by primary-income outflows.

reports.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
reports.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods. Key traditional exports include beef, cellulose, soybeans, dairy and other agro-industrial products.
reports._notes: Trade data feed the BOP and national accounts. Agro-industrial products (meat, cellulose, grains, dairy) dominate the export basket.

reports.title: Tasa de Política Monetaria (TPM) / Policy interest rate
reports.description: Main monetary-policy instrument of the BCU under the inflation-targeting regime. The rate at which the central bank signals the monetary stance.
reports._notes: Operational policy rate. Adjusted in discrete steps; recent path has moved from a more restrictive stance toward a more neutral/expansive one (e.g. 5.75% in early 2026 after cumulative cuts).

reports.title: Activos de reserva / International reserves
reports.description: Stock of international reserve assets managed by the central bank. Published at high frequency and analysed in the BOP and monetary reports.
reports._notes: Key external-buffer indicator. Continuously monitored alongside the net international investment position.

reports.title: Marco de metas de inflación — BCU
reports.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: explicit inflation targeting. The BCU sets a target range for annual CPI inflation and uses the TPM as the primary instrument.
reports._notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated.
_referenced_by: IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target band
Market and academic commentary on Uruguayan monetary policy

reports.title: Índice de Volumen Físico de la Industria Manufacturera (IVFIM)
reports.description: Monthly physical-volume index of manufacturing production. Principal high-frequency industrial-activity indicator.
reports._notes: Core short-term industry product. Published with variants (with/without refinery, core). Companion indices track hours worked and employment in manufacturing.

reports.title: Exportaciones de carne / Beef & meat exports
reports.description: Statistics of beef and other meat production and exports. Long-standing traditional export and a major component of the agro-industrial economy.
reports._notes: Signature traditional export. Continuously cited in trade and agro-sector analysis; Uruguay is a recognised high-quality beef exporter.

reports.title: Celulosa y forestal / Pulp & forestry exports
reports.description: Statistics of pulp (cellulose) and forestry-related production and exports. Major modern agro-industrial export line.
reports._notes: Structurally important export after large-scale pulp-mill investments. Frequently among the top export products by value.

reports.title: Sector agropecuario / Agricultural & livestock statistics
reports.description: Broader agricultural and livestock production and trade statistics (beef, dairy, grains, soybeans, etc.). Backbone of the traditional export economy.
reports._notes: Primary-sector parent node. Links the commodity-level series (meat, grains, dairy) to the external accounts and to rural economic activity.

reports.title: Encuesta Anual de Actividad Económica (EAAE)
reports.description: Annual structural business survey covering value added, employment, investment and other variables across economic activities.
reports._notes: Structural complement to the high-frequency IVFIM and national accounts. Provides detailed activity-level value-added and employment data.

reports.title: Montevideo — capital statistical identity
reports.description: Capital city and primary urban economy. Core domain for ECH labour, income and poverty analysis. Higher average incomes than the Interior but also elevated poverty incidence in peripheral areas.
reports._notes: Dominant metro node. Continuously published as a distinct geographic domain (Montevideo vs Interior) in ECH income and poverty reports. Intra-city periphery carries higher poverty than the southern coastal strip.

reports.title: Departamento de Artigas — high-poverty border contrast
reports.description: Northern border department with among the highest poverty incidence in the 2025 departmental results.
reports._notes: Poverty-contrast department. Frequently ranked with Rivera and Cerro Largo among the highest-poverty departments.

reports.title: Departamento de Rivera — high-poverty border contrast
reports.description: Northern border department with elevated poverty incidence. Completes the northern border contrast set.
reports._notes: 2025 poverty ranking places Rivera among the highest-poverty departments alongside Artigas and Cerro Largo.

reports.title: Departamento de Cerro Largo — high-poverty border contrast
reports.description: Northeastern border department with elevated poverty incidence.
reports._notes: Completes the high-poverty northern/northeastern border cluster.

reports.title: Departamento de Colonia — low-poverty contrast
reports.description: Southern department with among the lowest poverty incidence in the 2025 results.
reports._notes: Low-poverty southern department. Completes the contrast pole opposite the northern border departments.

reports.title: Pobreza por departamento (INE)
reports.description: Official departmental tabulations of income poverty. Primary source for the inter-departmental poverty gradient.
reports._notes: Key homogeneity-test product. 2025 extremes: Artigas, Rivera, Cerro Largo highest; San José, Maldonado, Colonia, Flores lowest. National persons under LP ~16.6%.

reports.title: MERCOSUR (ACE 18) — marco comercial
reports.description: Southern Common Market customs-union and trade framework of which Uruguay is a founding member. Core preferential-trade arrangement with Argentina, Brazil and Paraguay.
reports._notes: Foundational regional instrument. Continuously cited in Uruguayan trade and integration analysis. Uruguay has long advocated flexibility for smaller members within the bloc.
_referenced_by: Official trade reporting with MERCOSUR partners

reports.title: Acuerdo MERCOSUR–Unión Europea
reports.description: Trade agreement between MERCOSUR and the European Union. Provisional application of the interim trade agreement began in 2026; major preferential-access instrument for Uruguayan agro-exports.
reports._notes: Landmark external agreement. Continuously cited as a major opening for beef, dairy and other agro-products into the EU market.

reports.title: Presupuesto Nacional / National Budget
reports.description: Annual national budget law and subsequent execution reports covering revenues and expenditure of the central government.
reports._notes: Operational fiscal framework. Links tax and other revenues with functional spending on education, health, social protection and investment.

reports.title: Gasto público en educación y salud
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / INE
reports.description: Public expenditure on education and health as reflected in the national budget and related functional statistics. Complements household-survey education and health modules.
reports._notes: Education and health are major and constitutionally prioritised functional allocations. Continuously tracked in budget execution and social-policy analysis.

reports.title: Lácteos — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of dairy production and exports (whole milk powder, cheese, butter, etc.). Major traditional agro-industrial export and a significant rural employer.
reports._notes: Signature agro-export. 2025 export billing ~USD 965 mn (record/near-record). Whole milk powder dominates; Algeria and Brazil are leading destinations. Completes the agro-export triad with beef and cellulose.

reports.title: Instituto Nacional de la Leche (INALE)
reports.description: Sector institute that compiles and disseminates primary and commercial statistics for the dairy chain. Key analytical and policy-support body for the sector.
reports._notes: Primary statistical and analytical node for the dairy chain. Continuously cited in production, price and export analysis.

reports.title: Soja y granos — producción y exportaciones
reports.description: Statistics of soybean and other grain production and exports. Major component of the agricultural export basket alongside beef, cellulose and dairy.
reports._notes: Important traditional export line. Frequently ranks among the top merchandise exports by value.

reports.title: Dirección General Impositiva (DGI) — tax collection
reports.description: National tax administration. Publishes tax collection by type of tax and performance against annual targets.
reports._notes: Primary revenue-side fiscal statistic. Links the real-side economy to the central-government budget.

reports.title: Deuda pública / Public debt statistics
reports.publisher: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas / BCU
reports.description: Stock and flow statistics of central-government and public-sector debt (external and domestic). Key sustainability indicator.
reports._notes: Critical fiscal-sustainability node. Continuously monitored in macroeconomic and policy analysis.

reports.title: Departamento de Maldonado — low-poverty southern contrast
reports.description: Southern coastal department with among the lowest poverty incidence. Completes the low-poverty southern set alongside Colonia.
reports._notes: Low-poverty southern department; hosts important tourism and residential activity.

reports.title: Departamento de Canelones — core metropolitan periphery
reports.description: Large department surrounding Montevideo. Intermediate poverty and inequality; important demographic and economic weight in the greater capital region.
reports._notes: Completes the greater Montevideo statistical geography. Frequently cited in both poverty and inequality departmental rankings.

reports.title: Coeficiente de Gini / Income inequality
reports.description: Official Gini coefficient of income inequality, calculated from ECH income data. Published nationally and by department.
reports._notes: Companion inequality indicator to the poverty series. 2025 national Gini ~0.40. Montevideo, Salto and Canelones among the highest departmental inequality.

reports.title: Indicadores de empleo y desempleo (ECH)
reports.description: Labour-force indicators from the ECH: employment rate, unemployment rate, activity rate, and related quality-of-employment measures.
reports._notes: Primary high-frequency labour indicators. Derived from the same continuous household survey that underpins the poverty series.

reports.title: Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas — institutional fiscal identity
reports.description: Central finance ministry responsible for the national budget, public debt, tax policy coordination and macroeconomic fiscal reporting.
reports._notes: Institutional parent for the fiscal side. Continuously cited as the producer of budget, debt and fiscal-policy analysis.

reports.title: Banco de Previsión Social (BPS) — social-security coverage and finances
reports.description: Main social-security institution covering pensions, family allowances, unemployment benefits, sickness benefits and other social transfers. Major fiscal and social-protection actor.
reports._notes: Central social-protection node. 2025 benefit outlays on the order of USD 8+ bn, dominated by pensions. Continuously cited in fiscal, labour and social-policy analysis; cotizante counts are a key formal-employment indicator.

reports.title: Jubilaciones y pensiones (BPS)
reports.description: Pension and retirement benefit statistics administered by BPS. Largest single component of social-security expenditure.
reports._notes: Dominant BPS expenditure line. Hundreds of thousands of beneficiaries; major structural claim on public resources.

reports.title: Actividad de la construcción / Construction activity
reports.description: Statistics of construction activity, employment and related permits. Cyclically sensitive sector tracked via employment, permits and investment indicators.
reports._notes: Important short-term activity and employment sector. BPS cotizante counts in construction are a high-frequency formal-employment signal; unemployment benefits often concentrate in this sector in downturns.

reports.title: Turismo y hotelería / Tourism & hospitality
reports.description: Tourism and hospitality activity and employment statistics. Important services-export and seasonal employment sector, especially in coastal departments.
reports._notes: Services-side complement to the agro-export economy. Hospitality employment is a useful high-frequency signal of tourism and domestic consumption dynamics.

reports.title: FONASA / Seguro Nacional de Salud
reports.publisher: BPS / Ministerio de Salud Pública / MEF
reports.description: National health-insurance scheme financing coverage through mutualistas and the public provider (ASSE). Major component of the social-security and health-financing system.
reports._notes: Central health-financing mechanism. Linked to BPS contributions and to the public health budget; methodological parameters (e.g. CPE) are periodically reviewed.

reports.title: ASSE — Administración de los Servicios de Salud del Estado
reports.description: Public health-service provider. Complements the mutualista sector within the national health system.
reports._notes: Public provider side of the dual health system. Linked to FONASA financing and to the health functional budget.

reports.title: Departamento de Flores — low-poverty interior contrast
reports.description: Small interior department with among the lowest poverty and inequality incidence.
reports._notes: Completes the low-poverty set. Useful as a small-department contrast to the high-poverty border departments.

reports.title: Departamento de Salto — northern interior
reports.description: Northern interior department with elevated inequality and intermediate-to-higher poverty relative to the southern core.
reports._notes: Frequently appears among the higher-inequality departments. Completes the northern departmental set.

reports.title: Asignaciones familiares y transferencias (BPS)
reports.description: Family allowances and related cash-transfer programmes administered by BPS. Important social-protection instrument for households with children.
reports._notes: Key non-pension social-transfer line. Complements the pension system within the BPS benefit structure.

reports.title: Cotizantes BPS / Formal employment contributors
reports.description: Count of formal workers contributing to BPS. High-frequency formal-employment indicator complementary to the ECH labour series.
reports._notes: Useful formal-employment signal. Sectoral breakdowns (construction, hospitality, industry, agro, etc.) provide high-frequency insight into formal job dynamics.

reports.title: TLC MERCOSUR–Singapur
reports.description: Free-trade agreement between MERCOSUR and Singapore. Modern agreement covering goods, services, investment and public procurement. Entered into force for Uruguay in March 2026.
reports._notes: First MERCOSUR FTA with an Asian partner in force for Uruguay. Includes chapters on services, investment and public procurement. Continuously cited as a template for modern external agreements.
_referenced_by: MEF trade-agreement monitoring and origin-certificate reporting

reports.title: TLC MERCOSUR–EFTA
reports.description: Free-trade agreement between MERCOSUR and the European Free Trade Association. Signed September 2025; complements the broader EU relationship.
reports._notes: Completes the European preferential architecture alongside the MERCOSUR–EU interim agreement. Continuously cited in the external-agenda narrative.
_referenced_by: Export strategy for European markets beyond the EU
Policy debate on agro-export and industrial access

reports.title: ACE 35 MERCOSUR–Chile / bilateral Chile instruments
reports.description: Economic complementarity agreement and related bilateral instruments with Chile, including public-procurement and origin-regime modernisation.
reports._notes: Long-standing Pacific-facing instrument. Origin regime modernised in 2024–25; public-procurement agreement with Chile is among the earliest of its kind for Uruguay.

reports.title: Acuerdos de Promoción y Protección de Inversiones (APPI / BITs)
reports.description: Network of bilateral investment treaties (≈32 in force with 34 countries). Provides legal protection and, in a subset of cases, establishment rights for foreign investors.
reports._notes: Core legal infrastructure for FDI. Treaties with the US, Chile and Japan include liberalisation (establishment) provisions; most others are post-establishment protection instruments.

reports.title: Régimen de Zonas Francas
reports.publisher: Dirección Nacional de Zonas Francas / MEF
reports.description: Free-zone regime offering tax and customs incentives for industrial, commercial and services activities. Strategic instrument for logistics, manufacturing and global-services investment.
reports._notes: Flagship industrial/commercial promotion instrument. ~11–14 free zones in operation. Protocol with Brazil (Additional Protocol 83 to ACE 18) allows zero-tariff entry of free-zone goods into Brazil subject to origin rules — a material industrial-competitiveness lever.

reports.title: Ley de Promoción de Inversiones / COMAP regime
reports.description: General investment-promotion regime granting tax benefits (IRAE, wealth tax, import duties, VAT credits) for declared investment projects. Administered through COMAP.
reports._notes: Primary horizontal investment-incentive framework. Recent decrees have expanded 100% IRAE exemptions for large projects meeting employment and R&D/innovation criteria. Continuously cited in investor-climate materials.

reports.title: Uruguay XXI — investment & export promotion agency
reports.description: National agency for investment attraction and export promotion. Publishes investor guides, sector profiles and trade intelligence.
reports._notes: Institutional interface between the international agreements / incentive regimes and private investors and exporters. Continuously cited in FDI and export-strategy analysis.

reports.title: Acuerdos de Compras Públicas
reports.description: Public-procurement market-access agreements (Chile, MERCOSUR Protocol with Brazil, chapter in MERCOSUR–Singapore FTA). Open government procurement to foreign suppliers under reciprocal terms.
reports._notes: Commercial-side complement to goods and services trade agreements. Chile and Brazil instruments are in force; Singapore chapter is part of the broader FTA.

reports.title: Protocolo de Zonas Francas MERCOSUR–Brasil (ACE 18 Adicional 83)
reports.description: Additional protocol allowing goods produced in Uruguayan free zones to enter Brazil at zero tariff subject to origin rules. Material industrial-competitiveness instrument for free-zone manufacturing.
reports._notes: High-leverage industrial instrument. In force since 2022; frequently cited as the reason free-zone manufacturing can compete for the Brazilian market on equal footing with other regional hubs.
_referenced_by: Uruguay XXI and free-zone investment materials
Industrial-location decisions for export to Brazil

reports.title: Relación comercial y estratégica con China
reports.description: Strategic partnership and intensive bilateral trade relationship with China (top export destination). Includes dairy-protocol and broader economic cooperation; FTA negotiations and RCEP interest under discussion.
reports._notes: De-facto structural trade partner. Continuously cited in export-performance analysis even in the absence of a comprehensive bilateral FTA; dairy protocol and strategic-partnership language are recurring reference points.
_referenced_by: Export statistics (China often #1 destination for beef, soy, pulp)
Policy debate on Asia diversification and possible FTA/RCEP path

China is a top export destination; the bilateral relationship structures a large share of merchandise trade.

_consolidation.json_syntax_repair_note: These batch files were not valid JSON as delivered: "releases_per_year" carried an unquoted text value (missing opening quote), e.g. `"releases_per_year": continuous",`. Repaired mechanically by re-quoting the value verbatim. No number was invented.
_consolidation.cadence_note: A non-numeric cadence text was moved off releases_per_year into _cadence_original verbatim and the numeric field omitted, per the v2 spec (omitted, never null). Needs a human/judgement pass to become a real number.

_normalisation.note: Second pass, 2026-08-18: mechanical alignment to src/lib/types.ts. Nothing researched, nothing invented. Every original value that was replaced is preserved on the record under a key prefixed with an underscore.
rules: jurisdiction_level mapped into the six-value union; the delivered string kept as _jurisdiction_level_original.
domains: format-normalised, then any tag outside the 22 approved values prefixed "proposed:" as the spec directs. No semantic merging was done — that needs your call.

relationship_type: part_of edges moved onto the child node as part_of; contains edges reversed onto the child; produced_by edges dropped (publisher is a string, not a node); related_to / complements held in _dropped as deferred. Off-union values were poisoning every PageRank score with NaN.
last_updated added as null where absent (required field, string|null).
region filled with the country name where it was null or missing.
releases_per_year: unambiguous single-word cadences resolved to numbers; ambiguous text left in _cadence_original and listed under _gaps.unresolved_cadence.
source_kind mapped to official/commercial; delivered value kept as _source_kind_original.
Non-schema keys Grok wrote (shape, notes, referenced_by, ...) renamed with a leading underscore so they are visibly not part of the schema. Nothing deleted.

_gaps.note: What is genuinely missing and cannot be fixed mechanically — this is the research queue, not a defect list.
